_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$DownStage0: is Too Hungry and Can't Knock Enemies
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$Horsepower_FeedTutorial: Press the "feed" key to feed your horse on "grass" surfaces. This will provide certain buffs and remove debuffs. Keep it fed before your journeys!
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_AllowRagdoll_Desc: Remove the "No Knockdowns" flag of the horses. Changes will take effect after the game loads another horse with the same horse race (Form ID).
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_Graze_Desc: Enable the hunger / grazing system. Feed your horse when on grassy surfaces with sneak key. Horses will graze on their own as well.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_HitToleration_Desc: Horses do a rearup after taking hits between 5-20 randomly, including spells. There's a cooldown window to prevent stunlock. The horse has to be hit, not the rider.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_HorseAttack_Desc: Tap the shout key to command an attack. Damage scales with your unarmed damage. Hold the key instead to command a backwards kick. Assault against neutral NPCs will give you a bounty.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_MinJumpClamp_Desc: By default, your minimum jump height is increased. For compatibility with other mods that lower the default jump height, keep it off unless you see other issues.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_MinJumpClamp_Label: Allow Lower Jump Heights While Moving
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_Petting_Desc: Pet the horse with sneak key on horseback
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_SlopeSlide_Desc: Slide down from steep slopes. Ragdoll if the steep is too steep. Ragdoll only works with restored ragdoll option is turned on.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_SprintInterrupt_Desc: Getting too slow with your horse will cause it to rear-up
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_SprintKnock_Desc: Knock actors with a sprinting jump, requires graze level 1 or above if grazing is enabled.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_SprintStop_Desc: Plays when you stop moving while sprinting. Sprint to run transition is not affected.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$MCM_SwapInput_Desc: Left click to attack left, right click to attack right.
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$UpStage1: is No Longer Hungry and Can Sprint Normally
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$UpStage3: is Well Fed and Can Sprint Longer
line:menu_translation/horsepower:Interfa.$UpStage4: Feels Vigorous and Has Extra Health
